purpose: 90-minute local experimental bot run; not a public release or expert-strength certification
training_mode: playing PPO with the larger imitation bidder frozen; 20 percent controlled contracts
pilot: The initial staged run stopped at update 94 after 22.7 minutes on a 1000-attempt curriculum cap. The cap was raised to 10000. Its bidder expressed interest in 0.66 percent of learner hands, so the remaining budget uses a 30000-game / 20-epoch imitation warm start and frozen bidding.
selection: highest mean raw payout on the fixed 500-seed validation panel; includes the initial imitation pair
held_out_reference: the main run's larger imitation warm-start pair
controlled_reference: the main run's larger imitation warm-start player
seat_and_dealer_rotations: all four seats and all four dealers within each base-seed block
bootstrap: 2000 resamples of base-seed blocks; 95 percent percentile intervals
selection_after_holdout: none; report the chosen pair once without retuning or extending these panels
limitations: Smaller than the planned public-release confirmation suite; controlled diagnostics cover one Ruf suit, Wenz, and one Solo suit. Historical opponents and long human-session gates remain pending.
